description: This file defines a MediatR pipeline behavior that manages database transactions within the processing pipeline. It starts a transaction before handling a request, commits the transaction if successful, and rolls back in case of exceptions.

classes.name: DBContextTransactionPipelineBehavior
classes.description: A pipeline behavior for managing database transactions during request handling, ensuring atomicity of operations.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles the incoming request, begins a transaction, invokes the next delegate, commits if successful, or rolls back if an exception occurs.
